title: Parsing an Encoded Query
statement: For any natural number $n$, bit vector $b\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and Boolean words $t,a,x$, encode them as the concatenation of $b$ with the delimiter encoding of $t$, then two false bits, then the delimiter encoding of $a$, then two false bits, and finally $x$. Parsing this word with bit-vector length $n$ returns exactly $(b,t,a,x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ is a Boolean bit vector of length $n$
